extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology reconciliation from primary XML/PDF and supplementary PDF; claims are bounded and do not assert primary molecular causality beyond local evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TB_KKG6K and D-Lys_TB_KKG6K have candidacidal effects on planktonic and sessile Candida albicans cells, with Table 2 supporting reduced sessile CFU at 5x and 10x IC90.
direct_assay_types: CFU recovery from planktonic/sessile C. albicans
mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotypic killing evidence does not by itself establish the primary molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The primary paper reports concentration- and time-dependent intracellular ROS induction in Candida albicans after peptide treatment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The discussion explicitly treats ROS/membrane effects as linked phenotypes and does not prove whether they are primary or secondary mechanisms.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper links D-Lys_TB_KKG6K exposure with plasma membrane perturbation/cell death staining, but this remains a bounded associated-effect claim.
direct_assay_types: propidium iodide staining with antioxidant condition
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact figure-level RFU/PI quantification is not tabulated locally; no direct primary-target claim is promoted.
